parameters.query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM events) AS total_eventos, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT src_ip, count(*) AS eventos FROM events GROUP BY src_ip ORDER BY eventos DESC LIMIT 10) t) AS top_ips, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT eventid, count(*) AS cantidad FROM events GROUP BY eventid ORDER BY cantidad DESC) t) AS distribucion_eventid, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT username, password, count(*) AS intentos FROM events WHERE username IS NOT NULL GROUP BY username, password ORDER BY intentos DESC LIMIT 10) t) AS credenciales, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT type, count(*) AS cantidad FROM iocs WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY type ORDER BY cantidad DESC) t) AS iocs_24h
INSERT INTO reports (period_start, period_end, content) VALUES (now() - interval '24 hours', now(), '{{ $json.content }}'::jsonb)
